people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: What can David say yet more to you concerning the honor which is done to your servant? For you know your servant.
translations.bsb: What more can David say to You for honoring Your servant? For You know Your servant,
translations.kjv: What can ➔ David speak more to thee for the honour of thy servant? for thou knowest thy servant.
